mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) over the past 3 months signals an easing monetary cycle that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS has declined for 3 consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly increase in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) above 4.0% signals a deteriorating labor market that reduces corporate earnings growth expectations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of instances where UNRATE rises above 4.0% in a single month.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in industrial production (INDPRO) and an increase in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) signals a broad-based economic slowdown that triggers a flight to safety, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of instances where INDPRO declines and UNRATE increases in the same month.

mechanism_narrative: During a monetary tightening cycle (FEDFUNDS > 4.0% and rising for 3 months), a monthly increase in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) above 0.2 percentage points signals an impending recession, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of instances where UNRATE rises > 0.2pp in a month during a monetary tightening cycle (FEDFUNDS > 4.0% and rising for 3 months).

mechanism_narrative: A monthly increase in housing starts (HOUST) above 1500 thousand units signals strong consumer demand and economic expansion, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 60% of instances where HOUST exceeds 1500 thousand units in a month.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) over the past 6 months signals a tightening labor market that boosts corporate profit margins, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 60% of instances where UNRATE has declined for 6 consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in the consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) and a decrease in industrial production (INDPRO) signals stagflation, which leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of instances where CPIAUCSL rises and INDPRO falls in the same month.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly growth rate in real personal consumption (RSAFS) above 0.5% signals strong consumer spending, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 60% of instances where RSAFS growth exceeds 0.5% in a month.
